description: Pipeline input — selected node(s)/point(s) by id (Select → Node scope, or grab from selection). Emits each as a point; feed into Buffer to get a disk Space.
instructions:
Pipeline input — emits the selected canvas node(s) (junction points) as single points, scoped by Select → Node. References nodes by display id (e.g. Node001, comma-separated); with 'Grab ID from selection' on, the id stays synced to the node selection. One output handle per node, or a single bundle (`outputMode`).

STAMP: wire a Footing → Footing-to-Plan / Elevation / 3D-Mesh (or any origin-relative drawing / mesh) into the Stamp input and the node stamps a copy at each of its point(s) — placement by location.

TIP: wire the point output into Bloom / Buffer to grow each point into a Space.
